title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification (Second Revision)
scope: Prescribes the requirements and methods of sampling and test for packaged drinking water other than packaged natural mineral water.

clauses.title: Treatment and Processing
clauses.content: Water shall be derived from surface water or civic water supply or other underground source, subjected to decantation, filtration, demineralisation, reverse osmosis and disinfection.

clauses.title: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS)
clauses.content: Total dissolved solids (TDS) shall not exceed 500 mg/l.

clauses.title: Microbiological Requirements
clauses.content: Total coliform bacteria, Faecal streptococci and E. coli shall be absent in 250 ml of sample.
